description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It is used to manage large or time-consuming tasks without blocking the UI, such as expanding tree nodes in a dashboard. The main components are createProgressiveExpandController, which handles the batching logic, and useProgressiveExpand, a React hook that manages UI state around this process.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages progressive batch processing of items, with start and cancel methods, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller to provide UI state management (running, progress, counts) and control functions (startFromItems, cancel).
